entries.title: Job 31:1
segments: ¶I made a covenant with mine eyes; why then should I think upon a maid?

entries.title: Job 31:2
segments: For what portion of God [is there] from above? and [what] inheritance of the Almighty from on high?

entries.title: Job 31:3
segments: [Is] not destruction to the wicked? and a strange [punishment] to the workers of iniquity?

entries.title: Job 31:4
segments: Doth not he see my ways, and count all my steps?

entries.title: Job 31:5
segments: If I have walked with vanity, or if my foot hath hasted to deceit;

entries.title: Job 31:6
segments: Let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know mine integrity. {Let...: Heb. Let him weigh me in balances of justice}

words.text: . {Let...: Heb. Let him weigh me in balances of justice}

entries.title: Job 31:7
segments: If my step hath turned out of the way, and mine heart walked after mine eyes, and if any blot hath cleaved to mine hands;

entries.title: Job 31:8
segments: [Then] let me sow, and let another eat; yea, let my offspring be rooted out.

entries.title: Job 31:9
segments: ¶If mine heart have been deceived by a woman, or [if] I have laid wait at my neighbour's door;

entries.title: Job 31:10
segments: [Then] let my wife grind unto another, and let others bow down upon her.

entries.title: Job 31:11
segments: For this [is] an heinous crime; yea, it [is] an iniquity [to be punished by] the judges.

entries.title: Job 31:12
segments: For it [is] a fire [that] consumeth to destruction, and would root out all mine increase.

entries.title: Job 31:13
segments: If I did despise the cause of my manservant or of my maidservant, when they contended with me;

entries.title: Job 31:14
segments: What then shall I do when God riseth up? and when he visiteth, what shall I answer him?

entries.title: Job 31:15
segments: Did not he that made me in the womb make him? and did not one fashion us in the womb? {did not one...: or, did he not fashion us in one womb?}

words.text: ? {did not one...: or, did he not fashion us in one womb?}

entries.title: Job 31:16
segments: ¶If I have withheld the poor from [their] desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail;

entries.title: Job 31:17
segments: Or have eaten my morsel myself alone, and the fatherless hath not eaten thereof;

entries.title: Job 31:18
segments: (For from my youth he was brought up with me, as [with] a father, and I have guided her from my mother's womb;) {her: that is, the widow}

entries.title: Job 31:19
segments: If I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or any poor without covering;

entries.title: Job 31:20
segments: If his loins have not blessed me, and [if] he were [not] warmed with the fleece of my sheep;

entries.title: Job 31:21
segments: If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, when I saw my help in the gate:

entries.title: Job 31:22
segments: [Then] let mine arm fall from my shoulder blade, and mine arm be broken from the bone. {bone: or, chanelbone}

entries.title: Job 31:23
segments: For destruction [from] God [was] a terror to me, and by reason of his highness I could not endure.

words.text: to me, and by reason of his highness

entries.title: Job 31:24
segments: ¶If I have made gold my hope, or have said to the fine gold, [Thou art] my confidence;

entries.title: Job 31:25
segments: If I rejoiced because my wealth [was] great, and because mine hand had gotten much; {gotten...: Heb. found much}

entries.title: Job 31:26
segments: If I beheld the sun when it shined, or the moon walking [in] brightness; {sun: Heb. light} {in...: Heb. bright}

entries.title: Job 31:27
segments: And my heart hath been secretly enticed, or my mouth hath kissed my hand: {my mouth...: Heb. my hand hath kissed my mouth}

words.text: : {my mouth...: Heb. my hand hath kissed my mouth}

entries.title: Job 31:28
segments: This also [were] an iniquity [to be punished by] the judge: for I should have denied the God [that is] above.

entries.title: Job 31:29
segments: If I rejoiced at the destruction of him that hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him:

entries.title: Job 31:30
segments: Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin by wishing a curse to his soul. {mouth: Heb. palate}

entries.title: Job 31:31
segments: If the men of my tabernacle said not, Oh that we had of his flesh! we cannot be satisfied.

entries.title: Job 31:32
segments: The stranger did not lodge in the street: [but] I opened my doors to the traveller. {traveller: or, way}

entries.title: Job 31:33
segments: ¶If I covered my transgressions as Adam, by hiding mine iniquity in my bosom: {as Adam: or, after the manner of men}

words.text: : {as Adam: or, after the manner of men}

entries.title: Job 31:34
segments: Did I fear a great multitude, or did the contempt of families terrify me, that I kept silence, [and] went not out of the door?

entries.title: Job 31:35
segments: Oh that one would hear me! behold, my desire [is, that] the Almighty would answer me, and [that] mine adversary had written a book. {my...: or, my sign is that the Almighty will}

words.text: . {my...: or, my sign is that the Almighty will}

entries.title: Job 31:36
segments: Surely I would take it upon my shoulder, [and] bind it [as] a crown to me.

entries.title: Job 31:37
segments: I would declare unto him the number of my steps; as a prince would I go near unto him.

entries.title: Job 31:38
segments: If my land cry against me, or that the furrows likewise thereof complain; {complain: Heb. weep}

words.text: against me, or that the furrows

entries.title: Job 31:39
segments: If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money, or have caused the owners thereof to lose their life: {fruits: Heb. strength} {the owners...: Heb. the soul of the owners thereof to expire, or, breathe out}

words.text: : {fruits: Heb. strength} {the owners...: Heb. the soul of the owners thereof to expire, or, breathe out}

entries.title: Job 31:40
segments: Let thistles grow instead of wheat, and cockle instead of barley. The words of Job are ended. {cockle: or, noisome weeds}
